name: hpimd-pag-mpa-v1
run: cd /work && python pin_hpimd.py --dest /work/src > /out/pin.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/pin.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && cp hpimd_sim.py grade_hpimd.py test_hpimd_split.py AMENDMENT-HPIMD-0.2.md src/ && cd src && python -m py_compile hpimd_core.py hpimd_sim.py grade_hpimd.py test_hpimd_core.py test_hpimd_split.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc
cd /work/src && python -m unittest -v test_hpimd_core test_hpimd_split > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc
cd /work/src && sha256sum hpimd_core.py hpimd_sim.py grade_hpimd.py test_hpimd_core.py test_hpimd_split.py PREREG-v0.1.md AMENDMENT-HPIMD-0.2.md | tee /out/sha256.txt

cd /work/src && python hpimd_sim.py --model mace-mpa-0 --kind ctrl --runs 3 --out /out --budget-s 17000 --workers 2 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^HPIMD_' /out/run.txt; tail -n 40 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
